senses.gloss: m. (cmp. b. h. <cite ref="H01417"><he>חֹף</he></cite>; <cite ref="H01464"><he>חפף</he> I</cite>)

units: Num. R. s. 13 (ref. to Num. VII, 26) אין כף אלא חף וכ׳ Kaf (bowl) means the same as ḥaf (shore), as it is said (Ps. XCVIII, 8) rivers strike the Kaf.

senses.gloss: (cmp. חִיפָּא) [rim, ridge,] ward of a lock (פותחת); bit of a key (corresponding to the ward); pivot of a door (v. Sm. Ant. s. vv. Cardo, Clavis).
units: Sabb. VIII, 6 כדי … חף bone large enough to make of it a ḥaf; expl.

ib. 81ᵃ חַפֵּי פותחת the rims (ward) of a lock; Y. ib. 11ᵇ bot מהו חף סרגיד what ḥaf is meant? (Answ.) the key-ward; ib. תמן היא עביד חף בלוט וכ׳ (not כלוט) there (Kel. XIV, 8) he (R. Judah) uses ḥaf in the sense of a key-bit, and here (Sabb. l. c.) in the sense of a key-ward.

senses.gloss: the border of a web, used for starting a new web by fastening the warp to it. Y. ib. VII, 10ᶜ, v. נִיר IV.—Pl. חַפִּים, חַפִּין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:6">Kel. XIII, 6</cite> <he>פותחת של עץ וח׳ וכ׳</he> if the lock is of wood and its key-bits of metal (ed. Dehr. <he>חָפִין</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:8">Ib. XIV, 8</cite> <he>ניטלו ח׳</he> if the teeth of the bit are broken off (damaged).
<cite ref="Shabbat 81a:1">Sabb. 81ᵃ</cite>, v. supra. Y. ib. IV, 7ᵃ top <he>חַפֵּי לסוטות</he> borders used for weaving veils.
